title: After a page-hide flushSync during a pass that took an edit, the pass makes one more write though the sync write already landed everything
evidence: Was: in review. Found in lead A1 step c, 2026-11-12. packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts saveLoop: the pass that lands after flushSync sees a change it did not start from and makes another pass; save-state.ts passLanded also moves saved back to the pass start. Pinned as today by record-session.session.test.ts "a page-hide flushSync during a pass that took an edit makes one more pass". Owner ruled 2026-11-13 (needs_brad no): passLanded keeps the later of saved and the pass start, so a pass landing after a sync write asks for no extra pass; an edit after the sync write still gets one
